description: List all GW1 heroes, optionally filtered by profession or campaign name. Useful for team-building: shows which professions are coverable by heroes and how each hero is unlocked.

campaignName.description: Filter by the campaign the hero is recruited in, exact English name: Prophecies, Factions, Nightfall or Eye of the North.

professionName.description: Filter by the hero's profession, exact English name: Warrior, Ranger, Monk, Necromancer, Mesmer, Elementalist, Assassin, Ritualist, Paragon or Dervish.

name: list_heroes
title: List Guild Wars 1 heroes
